scope: Retain AC1018 DATATABLE frames raw-only when typed body parsing fails but an independent R2004 common shell and inline handle stream validate.

source.provenance: Tracked ACadSharp sample, read-only; not copied into this repository.

oda.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
oda.finding: The common non-entity object shell and handle stream are defined. This receipt makes no claim about the DATATABLE class-specific variable body; it is retained opaque.

authority.policy: Do not infer DataTable fields or semantics from shell validation. Preserve the exact frame only and retain strict output refusal.

implementation.profile: Exact AC1018 version, record DATATABLE, class AcDbDataTable, failed typed parse, and successful independent RawObjectShell parse.
implementation.behavior: Publish the unvalidated raw carrier with no typed DATATABLE callback after the common shell succeeds. A shell failure remains an object parse failure.

generatedControl.coverage: Two from-scratch AC1018 DATATABLE frames with bounded common fields and deliberately absent class body are framed with valid CRCs. Assertions require exact raw payloads, no typed callbacks, raw publication, and following-frame recovery. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

physicalRead.result: Both DATATABLE records use the raw-only route. Together with the preceding four TABLECONTENT/TABLEGEOMETRY recoveries, the read publishes 1014/1014 frames with zero entity/object parse failures. Strict DXF export remains refused by the independent IMAGEDEF/reactor source-correlation gate.

beforeThisSlice.result: The same source/command had 2 AcDbDataTable object failures and 1012/1014 frames published after TABLECONTENT/TABLEGEOMETRY recovery.

limits: This recovers exact frames/common shell only; DATATABLE body semantics remain unqualified.
No selected or whole-file DXF output is authorized by this raw fallback.
